test_cases.name: io_write
test_cases.desc: START=0000, CYCTYPE=I/O write, 16-bit addr, SYNC=READY, byte transferred LSN then MSN.

test_cases.name: io_read
test_cases.desc: START=0000, CYCTYPE=I/O read, peripheral drives SYNC=READY then data nibbles.

test_cases.name: memory_cycle
test_cases.desc: 32-bit memory address (8 nibbles), one byte of data.

test_cases.name: firmware_read
test_cases.desc: START=1101, 28-bit firmware address + IDSEL, fetch boot vector.

test_cases.name: dma_cycle
test_cases.desc: Peripheral asserts encoded LDRQ#; host runs DMA Read/Write cycle on a channel 0..7.

test_cases.name: abort
test_cases.desc: Host drives LFRAME# low >=4 clocks with LAD=1111; peripherals tri-state LAD.
